name: Sir Daniel Fortesque (Hecarim)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Features:

-New model and textures.

-New animations.

-New sounds.

-New voiceover

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-Full new Joke, Dance, Recall, Respawn, Taunt, Laugh and Death animations.

-Only one eye.


Sources:

-Model and texture extracted from Medievil: Resurrection and adapted to the game.

-Special thanks to Gui'sai for helping with the ultimate effect.

-Animations fully made by me.

-Sounds and voiceover from different Medievil games.
